container.root_filesystem: writable; WSLc exposes no rootfs read-only option

protocol.schedule: role index i%3; per-role fixture index (i*37+11)%4096
protocol.construction_gate: 3 construction tests pass and exact scorer parity is 12,288/12,288

decision.pass: all 30,000 predictions independently replay; exact source/reference/input/image identity; all 15 paired blocks complete; reuse wins >=12/15; median lifetime-cost ratio <=0.90; median break-even <=1000 with noncrossers censored at 1001; all 7 mutations rejected
decision.stop: any identity mismatch, runtime/container admission failure, candidate/auditor exception, missing raw output, or mutation-integrity error; zero retry
decision.hold: candidate and audit are clean but the preregistered amortization thresholds are not met
decision.fail: any retained expected prediction differs from candidate or independent oracle

scope: single retained synthetic seed-3788 package under WSLc/CPython 3.12.14; no cross-runtime comparison, PyTorch/framework speed, GUI/task success, production, GPU, model, or product claim
